title: Scuba

words.clue: The long rubber diving flipper is a ___.
words.reason: A separate manufactured diving flipper, not the whole cod fish.
words.pictureSubject: One long blue-and-yellow rubber diving fin with its foot pocket and broad flexible blade clearly visible, isolated on a tiny wet deck patch.

words.clue: The small underwater vehicle is a ___.
words.reason: Only sub is an underwater vehicle; other transport is in the other bank.
words.pictureSubject: One friendly yellow mini submarine with round windows, a small propeller and a few bubbles; no people or writing.

words.clue: The fish with a chin barbel is a ___.
words.reason: The only whole fish in this bank; fin is a rubber diving flipper.
words.pictureSubject: One recognizable mottled green-brown cod fish with its small chin barbel, whole fish in a gentle swimming pose, no other animals.

words.clue: The cleanup scoop made of mesh is a ___.
words.reason: Only net has mesh for scooping loose litter.
words.pictureSubject: One small marine-cleanup hand net with a pale mesh hoop and teal handle, empty, no animals or litter inside.

words.clue: Rinse the dive gear in the round water ___.
words.reason: A large round rinse container, unlike a cup or a zipped bag.
words.pictureSubject: One round blue plastic dive-gear rinse tub partly filled with clear water, entire rim and sides visible, no loose gear.

words.clue: The zipped dive-gear container is a ___.
words.reason: A zipped fabric luggage container, not a tub or drinking cup.
words.pictureSubject: One sturdy teal zipped dive duffel bag with handles and a shoulder strap, blank panels, no loose objects around it.

words.clue: Drink water from the small handleless ___.
words.reason: The small handleless drinking vessel, unlike the large rinse tub.
words.pictureSubject: One small orange handleless water cup at the dive base, open rim visible, no other containers.

words.clue: The paper plan of the reef route is a ___.
words.reason: Only map is a paper route plan.
words.pictureSubject: One unfolded waterproof reef map showing simple reef shapes, a curved route and a compass arrow, no words or numbers.

words.clue: The boat headwear with a brim is a ___.
words.reason: Only cap is brimmed headwear.
words.pictureSubject: One blue sun cap with a clearly projecting brim, plain fabric and no emblem, resting on a tiny boat-deck patch.

words.clue: The wooden pinch fastener on the line is a ___.
words.reason: A wooden clothespeg, distinct from the other large gear objects.
words.pictureSubject: One large wooden clothespeg clipped onto a short rinse-station drying line, with a tiny blank fabric corner held between its jaws.

words.clue: The gear covered in water drops is ___.
words.reason: Only wet is an adjective describing water on equipment; dip is a quick dunk.
words.pictureSubject: One pair of dive gloves visibly soaked with large clear water beads and dripping into a small puddle; no person or other gear.

words.clue: The bright daytime star is the ___.
words.reason: Only sun names the daytime star.
words.pictureSubject: One cheerful golden sun above a tiny curved strip of sparkling blue sea, large clear sun disk and rays, no written symbols.

words.clue: Put shore litter in the large lidded ___.
words.reason: Only bin is the large waste container.
words.pictureSubject: One large teal shore-cleanup bin with its lid slightly open and plain blank sides, no words or loose litter.

words.clue: The small name label on the gear is a ___.
words.reason: Only tag is a small attached identification label.
words.pictureSubject: One blank orange equipment tag with a punched hole and short cord, attached to a tiny corner of dark gear fabric; no lettering.

words.clue: Two rows of bag teeth close with a ___.
words.reason: The toothed fastener, unlike the attached label tag.
words.pictureSubject: A close-up of a large yellow gear-bag zipper, clear interlocking teeth and pull tab on a small teal fabric panel, no whole bag.

words.clue: All the diving equipment forms a ___.
words.reason: A complete collection of gear, unlike one label or fastener.
words.pictureSubject: One neatly arranged complete scuba kit: mask, fins, buoyancy vest, tank and regulator together, no person, no written labels.

words.clue: The team flies in the passenger ___.
words.reason: The only aircraft in this bank; van is a road vehicle.
words.pictureSubject: One white-and-teal passenger jet with visible wings and engines, three-quarter view above a tiny coastal cloud, no branding.

words.clue: The dive team drives the road ___.
words.reason: The only wheeled road vehicle in this bank.
words.pictureSubject: One friendly plain teal dive-team van with four wheels, side door and roof rack, parked on a tiny coastal ground patch, no writing or logo.

words.clue: A quick dunk in the water is a ___.
words.reason: Dip is the only noun for a quick dunk; wet is a state.
words.pictureSubject: Close-up of one child hand briefly dipping its fingertips into clear shallow water at the shore, small ripples and a short down-up motion arc, no text.

words.clue: Rest your bottom on the boat bench: ___.
words.reason: Only sit describes the seated position.
words.pictureSubject: One cheerful child in a lifejacket sitting upright on a small boat bench, feet down, calm pose, no loose gear or writing.

blendPictures.crab: One friendly red-orange crab with two large claws and several walking legs, whole body visible on a tiny pale seabed patch.
blendPictures.clam: One rounded two-part clam shell opened just enough to show the soft animal inside, no pearl or other animals, on a small sand patch.
blendPictures.swim: One cheerful scuba diver moving horizontally through clear water with a clear fin stroke, complete mask, regulator, tank and fins, an adult buddy small in the distance.
blendPictures.flag: One red cloth dive flag with a white diagonal stripe on a short boat pole, full flag visible, no letters or words.
blendPictures.grip: Close-up of one gloved diver hand firmly wrapped around a small dive torch, fingers visibly gripping the handle tightly.
blendPictures.drip: One diving fin hanging toe-down with three separate water droplets dripping slowly from its tip, no other objects.
blendPictures.drop: One diver hand releasing a glove above an open empty equipment basket, glove clearly falling with short downward motion accents.
blendPictures.clip: One large silver equipment carabiner clip with a clearly visible spring snap gate, isolated and easy to recognize, no other fasteners.
blendPictures.step: One single sturdy non-slip step between a dock edge and a dive boat, the step dominates the compact composition, no people.
blendPictures.spot: A close view of a small yellow reef fish with exactly one large round blue spot on its side, the round mark is dominant and clear.
blendPictures.flat: One broad smooth reef stone with a clearly level flat top, shown low from the side on a tiny sand patch, no people or animals.
blendPictures.plug: One black rubber rinse-tub drain plug with a pull loop, beside a small round drain rim, no text or other equipment.

blendPictures.scan: One fully equipped diver looking carefully left and right across a reef, mask and dive torch directed outward with a gentle side-to-side viewing arc; no writing.
blendPictures.spin: One fully equipped diver turning round in place in clear water, a clear curved circular motion arrow around the body, no writing.
blendPictures.brim: Close-up of the broad front brim of a blue sun cap used on the dive boat, simple curved highlight indicating the projecting brim, no letters.
blendPictures.stop: One fully equipped upright diver holding a palm outward in a clear stop gesture and remaining still, complete mask, regulator, tank and fins.
blendPictures.slug: One colourful soft sea slug with small sensory tentacles and no hard shell, whole body visible on a tiny seabed stone, no other animals.
blendPictures.skin: Close-up of one bare hand and forearm showing smooth natural skin, a small blue water edge in the background, neutral and non-graphic, no cuts, injuries or writing.

scenes.title: Dive boat
scenes.sceneSubject: A friendly dive boat at a calm coastal dock, clean equipment preparation space, a sunny cabin and clear blue sea, diverse older children with an adult dive instructor preparing gear on deck; no lettering or logos.

scenes.title: Reef
scenes.sceneSubject: A colourful clear-water reef with gently rolling sand, smooth rocks, sea plants and a few distinct marine animals, an adult guide with fully equipped young divers observing from a respectful distance without touching coral; no text.

scenes.title: Dive base
scenes.sceneSubject: A welcoming coastal dive base with a shaded rinse station, neat gear storage, a small nearby team van and a distant passenger jet above the coast, children and an adult instructor preparing for an outing on dry land; blank signs and no lettering.

coverSubject: A welcoming guided scuba adventure in sparkling clear water: two cheerful fully equipped young divers and a friendly adult dive instructor with masks, regulators, tanks and fins, colourful reef life below and a small dive boat near the surface, the group large and easy to see, no touching coral, no writing or logos.
rainSubject: The coastal dive base during gentle rain, diverse children and an adult instructor safely preparing gear under a broad shelter on shore, visible raindrops, wet dock boards and a moored dive boat in the background, calm friendly mood, no lightning, no written signs.
